content.name: Continual Flame

m.text: ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

content.name: Continual Flame

m.text: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
